{{Quote|The generals command. We implement.|Clone trooper commander [[Bly/Legends|Bly]]|<ref name="Republic 68">[[Republic 68|''Republic'' 68]]</ref>}}
'''Clone Commanders''' were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] bred on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for leadership roles in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] or they worked themselves up in battle. They fought in the galaxy-wide conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Sometimes, however, smaller regiments and [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] were led by clone [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], like [[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]], who led the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]. When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] needed a group of clone troopers, no matter what size, a clone commander would usually join the group to assist the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]].

==Rank Differences==
[[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone marshal commander]] - He commanded an entire [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of 36,864 soldiers along with a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]].

[[Senior clone commander]] - He commanded a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of 9,216 soldiers along with a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and is subordinate to the clone marshal commander.

[[Clone regimental commander]] - He is in command of a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of 2,304 soldiers and is under the orders of a senior clone commander.

[[Clone battalion commander]] - He is in command of a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of 576 soldiers and is under the orders of a clone regimental commander.

They all wore the same yellow color markings and badges of rank in the form of four yellow dots on their left armor breastplate on their [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]].

==Commander training==
[[File:Phase1CloneCommanderYellow.jpg|thumb|left|145px|A clone commander in Phase I armor.]]
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] received [[Flash training|flash-training]] to fulfill their advanced roles and were also bred with extra capacity for autonomy, tactical thinking, and coordination. In combat, they were often assigned to field command centers but participated with their fellow [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in combat if the situation required it. Their equipment training included the standard [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] as well as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] such as the [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifle]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

===ARC training===
After success with [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], some ARCs, like [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]], returned to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to retrain clone commanders with ARC skills, making the commanders more independent than they once were. After the commanders were trained, they earned the title "[[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC commander]]," then returned to their legion to train their best clones and assistants in their new skills. Their new, independent training led to distinct personalities among the commanders.

==Personalization==
In the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were distinguished by yellow markings on their armor and helmets. The retrained ARC commanders often added more items to their armor, like ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Kama/Legends|kamas]] and [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]]. Commanders would also don other peripherals like [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] or Commander [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara's]] cheek plating. Some commanders allowed their best troops to also wear ARC [[Armor/Legends|armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', clone commanders are shown as [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]] with a shoulder-mounted [[Chaingun/Legends|chaingun]] and a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]].
